# Lisbon, May 2026

The flight leaves Frankfurt on 14 May at 07:35 with TAP, flight TP 573, and
lands in Lisbon at 09:50 local time. Seats 12A and 12C are booked; one suitcase
of 23 kilograms is included. The return flight is on 21 May at 18:10.

We stay at a small guesthouse in Alfama, Rua dos Remédios 41, second floor. The
room has a balcony towards the river. Check-in is from 14:00, but the owner,
Senhora Costa, keeps luggage from the morning on. Breakfast is not included;
the café next door opens at eight.

On Saturday we take the train from Rossio station to Sintra, about forty minutes.
Tickets for the Pena Palace must be booked online for a fixed time slot; we have
the 11:00 slot. Walk up through the park instead of the bus, and bring water.
